title: erased nature sutured in broken hopes of shattered myopic fractured lenses on a world trapped in freedom of THOUGHT #smallpoems
summary: erased nature sutured in broken hopes of shattered myopic fractured lenses on a world trapped in freedom of THOUGHT #smallpoems

body_html:
erased nature
sutured in broken hopes
of shattered
myopic fractured
lenses on
a world
trapped
in freedom of
THOUGHT
